hypothesis: The useful ROOM descendant is not a cube or an infinite node canvas. It is an ordered computational material: typed blocks sit on a carrier, adjacency is legible composition, seam type is encoded as a deterministic key, contiguous working spans compile into reusable cassettes, ENTER reveals derivation, and model-fit remains distinct from physical contract-fit.
preserves: ROOM 0.1 cube probe and SPACE SCALE 0.2 canvas as unequal donors
implemented: Hard-edge full-screen material rail projection with no freeform canvas or wire spaghetti.
Ordered slots over the existing SpaceScale model; focus is one aperture rather than a dashboard.
Deterministic seam key for each port type, exposed as a candidate print/tactile/optical code rather than decorative wiring.
One-hand MARK → move → FOLD SPAN compiles contiguous siblings into a reversible cassette.
ENTER / BACK traverses composite derivation without changing object identity.
FORK clones a subtree for a local counterfactual; DISSOLVE restores children.
RUN uses the existing safe operator graph; RECIPE emits an ordered material-rail projection.
MODEL ↔ REALITY binding explicitly separates tolerance-bounded model fit from independent physical contract fit.
Keyboard and touch-swipe focus navigation; mobile retains the same operational surface.
evidence_gate: Use the rail to encode one real configuration sequence. Pass only if adjacency/keying + cassette folding makes composition/re-entry clearer than a plain ordered list while preserving derivation. If the rail is just a prettier pipeline, park the UI and keep only seam-key/cassette mechanics.
next_if_pass: Bind one cassette recipe to a harmless physical witness: printable keyed seam token, rail slot, panel/cassette arrangement, or measured HOUSE planning fixture. Record model fit and physical contract fit independently.
next_if_fail: Retain rail-core seam keying and cassette recipe as donors; stop inventing global ROOM UIs.
